list: Unlock all the stories in See You Soon

The canoe that shall carry you to tomorrow has already arrived at dock, marking the beginning of your next long journey.
Look, tomorrow is yet to come, but we've already arrived! Why not take a moment to catch our breath? The scenery along the way is ever so beautiful.
During the See You Soon event, obtain the outfit Rose Rider

Verdant rides his motorcycle through bustling streets and narrow alleys. The balloons held by his 'scarecrow' drift in the wind, mirroring the festive mood of the people.
As he hustles about, delivering heartfelt messages, might he also attracts some admiring glances?
